2
Yakob ne Yuda mma
1 # 1 Be 4 Yeinom ne Israel mma: Ruben, Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Sebulon, #Gye 35.23-26 2Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad ne Aser.
3 # Gye 38.1-7 Yuda mma ne: Er, Onan ne Sela. Baasa yi na Kanaanni Sua babaa wo maa no. Na Yuda abakan Er yɛɛ AWURADE anim bɔne, na ɔkumm no. 4#Gye 38.29-30 Na n’ase Tamar woo Peres ne Sera maa no. Na Yuda mma nyinaa yɛ baanum.
5 # Gye 46.12 Peres mma ne: Hesron ne Hamul. 6Na Sera mma ne: Simri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol ne Dara, wɔn nyinaa yɛ baanum. 7#Yos 7 Na Karmi mma ne: Israel hawfoɔ Akar a ɔfom ahyiradeɛ mu no. 8Na Etan ba ne: Asaria.
Dawid asefoɔ
9 # Rut 4.19-22; Mat 1.3; 1 Be 2.18, 42 Na Hesron mma a wɔwoo wɔn maa no ne: Yerahmeel ne Ram ne Kelubai. 10Na Ram woo Aminadab, na Aminadab woo Nahson, Yuda mma bapɔmma no, 11na Nahson woo Salma, na Salma woo Boas, 12na Boas woo Obed, na Obed woo Yisai. 13#1 Sa 16.6-10 Na Yisai woo n’abakan Eliab ne Abinadab a ɔtɔ so mmienu ne Sima a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa, 14Netanel tɔ so nnan, Radai tɔ so nnum, 15#1 Sa 17.12 Osem tɔ so nsia, Dawid tɔ so nson. 16#2 Sa 2.18 Na wɔn nua mmaanom ne Seruia ne Abigail; na Seruia mma ne Abisai, Yoab ne Asa-el. Wɔyɛ baasa. 17#2 Sa 17.25 Na Abigail woo Amasa, na Amasa n’agya ne Ismaelni Yeter.
18 # 1 Be 2.9, 42 Na Hesron ba Kaleb ne ne yere Asuba, ne Yeriot woe; na ne mma nie: Yeser, Sobab ne Ardon. 19#1 Be 2.50 Na Asuba wui, na Kaleb faa Efrat waree, na ɔwoo Hur maa no. 20#Eks 31.2 Na Hur woo Uri, na Uri woo Besalel.
21Na akyire yi no Hesron kɔɔ Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead n’agya babaa ho, na ɔwaree no, nso na wadi mfirinhyia aduosia, na ɔwoo Segub maa no, 22#Ate 10.3 na Segub woo Yair, ɔno na Gilead asase so nkuro aduonu mmiɛnsa yɛɛ ne dea. 23#1 Ah 4.13 Na Gesur ne Aram gyee Yair atenaeɛ no firii wɔn nsam, Kenat ne ɛho nkurowa, ɛyɛ nkuro aduosia. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Gilead n’agya Makir mma. 24#1 Be 4.5 Na Hesron wuu wɔ Kaleb-Efrata akyiri no, Hesron yere Abia woo Ashur a ɔyɛ Tekoa n’agya maa no.
25 # 1 Be 2.9 Na Hesron abakan Yerahmeel mma ne: Abakan Ram, Buna, Oren Osem ne Ahia. 26Na Yerahmeel wɔ yere foforɔ bi a ne din de Atara, ɔne Onam ne na. 27Na Yerahmeel abakan Ram mma ne: Maas, Yamin ne Eker. 28Na Onam mma ne: Samai ne Yada. Na Samai mma ne: Nadab ne Abisur. 29Na Abisur yere din de Abihail, na ɔwoo Ahban ne Molid maa no. 30Na Nadab mma ne: Seled ne Apaim, na Seled wui a wannya mma. 31Na Apaim ba ne: Yisi. Na Yisi ba ne: Sesan. Na Sesan ba ne: Ahlai. 32Na Samai nua Yada mma ne: Yeter ne Yonatan. Na Yeter wui a wannya mma. 33Na Yonatan mma ne: Pelet ne Sasa. Yeinom ne Yerahmeel mma. 34Na Sesan nni mmammarima gye sɛ mmammaa. Na Sesan wɔ akoa Misraimni bi a ne din de Yarha. 35Na Sesan de ne babaa maa n’akoa Yarha awareɛ, na ɔwoo Atai maa no. 36Na Atai woo Natan, na Natan woo Sabad. 37Na Sabad woo Eflal, na Eflal woo Obed, 38na Obed woo Yehu, na Yehu woo Asaria, 39na Asaria woo Heles, na Heles woo Eleasa, 40na Eleasa woo Sisemai, na Sisemai woo Salum, 41na Salum woo Yekamia, na Yekamia woo Elisama.
42 # 1 Be 2.18 Na Yerahmeel nua Kaleb mma ne: N’abakan Mesa a ɔne Sif agya ne Hebron agya Maresa mma. 43Na Hebron mma ne: Kora ne Tapua ne Rekem ne Sema. 44Na Sema woo Raham, Yorkeam agya. Na Rekem woo Samai. 45Na Samai ba ne Maon. Na Maon yɛ Bet-sur agya. 46Na Kaleb mpena Efa woo Haran ne Mosa ne Gases. Na Haran woo Gases. 47Na Yahdai mma ne: Regem ne Yotam ne Gesan ne Pelet ne Efa ne Saaf. 48Na Kaleb mpena Maaka woo Seber ne Tirhana, 49#Yos 15.16; Ate 1.12 na ɔwoo Saaf a ɔyɛ Madmana n’agya, Sewa a ɔyɛ Makbena n’agya, ne Gibea n’agya. Na Kaleb babaa ne Aksa. 50#1 Be 2.19 Yeinom ne Kaleb mma.
Efrata abakan Hur mma ne: Sobal, Kiriat-yearim a ɔyɛ n’agya, 51Salma a ɔyɛ Betlehem n’agya, Haref a ɔyɛ Bet-gader n’agya. 52Na Sobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-yearim n’agya wɔ mma, wɔne Haroe ne Menuhotfoɔ wɔ afa. 53#1 Be 4.2 Na Kiriat-yearim mmusua ne Yitrifoɔ ne Putifoɔ ne Sumatifoɔ ne Misraimfoɔ deɛ no, yeinom mu na Sorafoɔ ne Estaolfoɔ fire. 54#1 Be 9.16 Salma mma ne: Betlehem ne Netofafoɔ Atrot-bet-yoab ne Manahatfoɔ fa ne Sorifoɔ no 55#Ate 1.16; Yer 35 ne atwerɛfoɔ mmusua a wɔte Yabes no: Tirafoɔ, Simeafoɔ, Sukafoɔ. Wɔne Kinifoɔ a wɔyɛ Hamat a ɔyɛ Rekab fie agya no asefoɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yeinom ne Israel mma: Ruben, Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Sebulon, Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad ne Aser.
Yuda mma ne: Er, Onan ne Sela. Baasa yi na Kanaanni Sua babaa wo maa no. Na Yuda abakan Er yɛɛ AWURADE anim bɔne, na ɔkumm no. Na n’ase Tamar woo Peres ne Sera maa no. Na Yuda mma nyinaa yɛ baanum.
Peres mma ne: Hesron ne Hamul. Na Sera mma ne: Simri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol ne Dara, wɔn nyinaa yɛ baanum. Na Karmi mma ne: Israel hawfoɔ Akar a ɔfom ahyiradeɛ mu no. Na Etan ba ne: Asaria.

Na Hesron mma a wɔwoo wɔn maa no ne: Yerahmeel ne Ram ne Kelubai. Na Ram woo Aminadab, na Aminadab woo Nahson, Yuda mma bapɔmma no, na Nahson woo Salma, na Salma woo Boas, na Boas woo Obed, na Obed woo Yisai. Na Yisai woo n’abakan Eliab ne Abinadab a ɔtɔ so mmienu ne Sima a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa, Netanel tɔ so nnan, Radai tɔ so nnum, Osem tɔ so nsia, Dawid tɔ so nson. Na wɔn nua mmaanom ne Seruia ne Abigail; na Seruia mma ne Abisai, Yoab ne Asa-el. Wɔyɛ baasa. Na Abigail woo Amasa, na Amasa n’agya ne Ismaelni Yeter.
Na Hesron ba Kaleb ne ne yere Asuba, ne Yeriot woe; na ne mma nie: Yeser, Sobab ne Ardon. Na Asuba wui, na Kaleb faa Efrat waree, na ɔwoo Hur maa no. Na Hur woo Uri, na Uri woo Besalel.
Na akyire yi no Hesron kɔɔ Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead n’agya babaa ho, na ɔwaree no, nso na wadi mfirinhyia aduosia, na ɔwoo Segub maa no, na Segub woo Yair, ɔno na Gilead asase so nkuro aduonu mmiɛnsa yɛɛ ne dea. Na Gesur ne Aram gyee Yair atenaeɛ no firii wɔn nsam, Kenat ne ɛho nkurowa, ɛyɛ nkuro aduosia. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Gilead n’agya Makir mma. Na Hesron wuu wɔ Kaleb-Efrata akyiri no, Hesron yere Abia woo Ashur a ɔyɛ Tekoa n’agya maa no.
Na Hesron abakan Yerahmeel mma ne: Abakan Ram, Buna, Oren Osem ne Ahia. Na Yerahmeel wɔ yere foforɔ bi a ne din de Atara, ɔne Onam ne na. Na Yerahmeel abakan Ram mma ne: Maas, Yamin ne Eker. Na Onam mma ne: Samai ne Yada. Na Samai mma ne: Nadab ne Abisur. Na Abisur yere din de Abihail, na ɔwoo Ahban ne Molid maa no. Na Nadab mma ne: Seled ne Apaim, na Seled wui a wannya mma. Na Apaim ba ne: Yisi. Na Yisi ba ne: Sesan. Na Sesan ba ne: Ahlai. Na Samai nua Yada mma ne: Yeter ne Yonatan. Na Yeter wui a wannya mma. Na Yonatan mma ne: Pelet ne Sasa. Yeinom ne Yerahmeel mma. Na Sesan nni mmammarima gye sɛ mmammaa. Na Sesan wɔ akoa Misraimni bi a ne din de Yarha. Na Sesan de ne babaa maa n’akoa Yarha awareɛ, na ɔwoo Atai maa no. Na Atai woo Natan, na Natan woo Sabad. Na Sabad woo Eflal, na Eflal woo Obed, na Obed woo Yehu, na Yehu woo Asaria, na Asaria woo Heles, na Heles woo Eleasa, na Eleasa woo Sisemai, na Sisemai woo Salum, na Salum woo Yekamia, na Yekamia woo Elisama.
Na Yerahmeel nua Kaleb mma ne: N’abakan Mesa a ɔne Sif agya ne Hebron agya Maresa mma. Na Hebron mma ne: Kora ne Tapua ne Rekem ne Sema. Na Sema woo Raham, Yorkeam agya. Na Rekem woo Samai. Na Samai ba ne Maon. Na Maon yɛ Bet-sur agya. Na Kaleb mpena Efa woo Haran ne Mosa ne Gases. Na Haran woo Gases. Na Yahdai mma ne: Regem ne Yotam ne Gesan ne Pelet ne Efa ne Saaf. Na Kaleb mpena Maaka woo Seber ne Tirhana, na ɔwoo Saaf a ɔyɛ Madmana n’agya, Sewa a ɔyɛ Makbena n’agya, ne Gibea n’agya. Na Kaleb babaa ne Aksa. Yeinom ne Kaleb mma.
Efrata abakan Hur mma ne: Sobal, Kiriat-yearim a ɔyɛ n’agya, Salma a ɔyɛ Betlehem n’agya, Haref a ɔyɛ Bet-gader n’agya. Na Sobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-yearim n’agya wɔ mma, wɔne Haroe ne Menuhotfoɔ wɔ afa. Na Kiriat-yearim mmusua ne Yitrifoɔ ne Putifoɔ ne Sumatifoɔ ne Misraimfoɔ deɛ no, yeinom mu na Sorafoɔ ne Estaolfoɔ fire. Salma mma ne: Betlehem ne Netofafoɔ Atrot-bet-yoab ne Manahatfoɔ fa ne Sorifoɔ no ne atwerɛfoɔ mmusua a wɔte Yabes no: Tirafoɔ, Simeafoɔ, Sukafoɔ. Wɔne Kinifoɔ a wɔyɛ Hamat a ɔyɛ Rekab fie agya no asefoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
